pick.headline: Gunmen massacre worshippers at Istanbul's Neve Shalom synagogue

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 173, 8 September 1986
evidence.snippet: …5 September, Beirut radio reported. In Israel, The Jerusalem Post noted that the hijack followed reports that members of the terrorist zroup led by Sabri al-Banna, alias Abu Nidal, had been sighted in the Karachi area. Istanbul Synagogue Attack — Twenty-four people were killed in a 6 September attack on Jews praying at an Istanbul syn- agogue, Ankara radio reported, disclosing that the two Arabs who carried out the attack died in the building.…
